name: aifinpay
description: Non-custodial AiFinPay payment and quote tools for AI agents. Fund-moving paths are fail-closed unless operator spend limits, trusted pricing and canonical audited deployment targets are verified.

env.AIFINPAY_AGENT_SECRET: local agent wallet credential; omit only for an unfunded ephemeral testing identity
env.AIFINPAY_MAX_USD: mandatory positive finite operator ceiling for fund-moving tools

tools.name: agent_call
tools.description: Registry-resolved provider call. Payment is refused unless operator spend limits and the canonical payment target pass all trust checks.

tools.name: payable_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a URL and handle a supported 402 only when request-bound authorization, value and target validation all pass.

tools.name: agent_address
tools.description: Return locally derived wallet identities. No funds move.

tools.name: pay_with_split
tools.description: Fee-on-top settlement tool. Legacy fee-inclusive splitter versions and not-yet-audited deployments are rejected.

tools.name: quote_split
tools.description: Preview fee-on-top payment components without signing.

production_support_policy: A chain or asset is production-supported only when the exact published artifact is mapped to the canonical deployment registry, runtime-verified, covered by reproducible E2E tests and approved by the final security audit.
